title: Introduction to Bioinformatics using NGS data
text:
An introductory workshop on applied bioinformatic next-generation sequence analyses covering the followings major topics:

Working on the UNIX/LINUX command line
Bioinformatic/NGS data formats and QC
DNA variant calling workflow essentials
RNA sequence analysis workflow essentials
